notes: REF-BM-02: metadata fetch collects title/description/favicon but never a preview image (no og:image). REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable, but no note field exists. REF-BM-06: submit always prepends a new item; no existing-url detection or convergence to edit. REF-BM-10: tags are a plain text input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/domain/tags but not note (absent) and only domain, not full url. REF-BM-14: #tag syntax not parsed; tags stored without # so '#x' never matches. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-20: no multi-select of bookmarks. REF-BM-21: no bulk action over filtered collection. REF-BM-22: toolbar shows static 'Sorted by recent' text only; no sort-key control or sorting logic. REF-BM-23: no markdown note or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive concept; only favorite/read/delete. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: only an ephemeral grid/list view toggle; no persisted personal settings (default sort, displayed items, font size).
